title: Measured first: envpool, 4 PyTorch threads
text: envpool runs Breakout at about 4,000 agent steps/s with random actions (8-32 games), gymnasium's AsyncVectorEnv at 1,700-1,900, so envpool it is. The full PPO loop (8 games x 128 steps, 4 epochs x 4 minibatches, Nature CNN on CPU) runs at about 288 agent steps/s with 4 PyTorch threads, the same as with 6 and faster than with 8 (225: the CPU has 4 physical cores). 10 M frames = 2.5 M agent steps = about 2.4 hours, well inside the 12-hour budget, so no compiled port (ml-speedup) is needed. The update is 3/4 of the time.

title: Smoke test passed (10 minutes, with a crash-resume in the middle)
text: Two 5-minute halves: the second resumed from checkpoints/smoke/latest.pt at iteration 83 (340k frames) and continued to 655k frames. Checkpoints every 100k frames, MLflow metrics and the site files all written. Training score after 655k frames: about 2 per game, as expected this early (random play scores about 1.4).

title: Main run started: CleanRL settings, 10 M frames
text: Seed 1, 8 envs x 128 steps, 4 epochs x 4 minibatches of 256, clip 0.1, lr 2.5e-4 annealed linearly to 0, entropy 0.01, value coef 0.5, GAE lambda 0.95, gamma 0.99, grad norm 0.5. Episodic life and reward clipping for training only. Checkpoints every 500k frames; supervise.sh restarts from the last one after a crash.
